messages:
csm_oliver: FYI customer reported suspected phishing -> edge proxy creds found in third-party log. Customer wants immediate rotation + guidance on KMS/HSM and audit retention. Customer ID: cust_8421. Key prefix they saw: rk_live_abc123 (they redacted middle).
eng_oncall: Can you paste the exact log snippet (redacted) and confirm whether the key appears in client-side logs or server-side proxy logs?
sre_maya: Also need timeframe when exposure happened and which region/edge proxy (us-west-2?).
csm_oliver: Pasted sample (redacted) from customer: "proxy_request": {"auth":"rk_live_abc123...","path":"/v1/generate"} — they say this was captured by a partner CDN on Tue 02:13 UTC.
sec_jun: Ok prioritizing. Immediate steps: 1) Rotate the key. 2) Invalidate any sessions tied to that key. 3) Pull audit logs for all activity from that key id since 02:00 UTC. 4) Suggest KMS/HSM-backed key for prod.
eng_oncall: I can rotate for them if they authorize. Rotation API (admin):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/admin/keys/rotate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"customer_id":"cust_8421","key_prefix":"rk_live_abc123"}'
```
Response will return new key metadata; we never return full raw key to public channels.
csm_oliver: Customer gave verbal OK to rotate, wants to know replication timing and whether old key will be immediately revoked.
eng_oncall: We rotate and issue new key, and by default we set old key to revoked = true immediately. Propagation to all edge proxies is typically <30s but recommend they swap client config right away.
sre_maya: I'll run audit query to capture all calls from that key. Example ES query (internal):
```
POST /_search
{ "query": { "term": { "api_key.prefix": "rk_live_abc123" }}, "sort": [{"@timestamp":"asc"}] }
```
I'll export activity and tag any anomalous IPs.
sec_jun: Regarding KMS/HSM: recommend customers enable KMS-wrapped key material for production. For on-prem HSM we support BYOK with HSM wrap + attestation. We should offer a migration plan: create a KMS-wrapped key, update service to reference KMS key id, rotate with zero-downtime using dual-key acceptance window.
support_bot: Note: Compliance policy requires logging of rotation actions and retaining key rotation events for 1 year by default.
eng_oncall: Also tell customer to purge cached configs on any client devices and CDN edge caches. If their SDK logged the key client-side, they must treat all clients as potentially compromised.
csm_oliver: Customer asked about audit log retention window and whether we can produce tamper-evident logs.
sec_jun: We retain detailed audit logs for 13 months by default; we can provide signed, tamper-evident export (WORM) on request — that's an enterprise add-on. Offer to start an export and notarize it.
sre_maya: I'll attach initial audit export to the ticket and flag suspicious IPs for blocklist.
csm_oliver: Customer also wants guidance on rotating keys used by device fleet (edge proxies) without mass downtime. Any standard playbook?
eng_oncall: Standard approach: 1) Create new key, 2) deploy dual-accept (accept both old+new) for a short window, 3) update clients to new key, 4) revoke old key once adoption >99%. If clients cannot be updated quickly, we can issue short-lived tokens instead via a token broker.
sec_jun: Recommend enabling short TTLs and token-exchange with KMS-backed signing for devices moving forward. Also review SDKs to ensure they never log secrets (`console.log`, verbose debug).
csm_oliver: Customer accepted rotating now. Eng_oncall — please proceed and confirm when done; sec_jun — escalate to security on-call for review.
eng_oncall: Starting rotation now. Will post completion + new key metadata via secure channel (not here). ETA ~2m.
support_bot: Rotation action queued: action_id=rot-20260309-001.
eng_oncall: Rotation complete. Old key revoked, new key issued and tied to cust_8421. Propagation confirmed across us-west-2 and eu-central. Please instruct customer to pull new key from the console or our secure transfer endpoint.
sec_jun: I've kicked off a security review and requested a WORM audit export. Also recommended immediate MFA/credential checks for the partner who reported the log leak.
csm_oliver: I'll update the customer and ask for confirmation when they've swapped keys. Thanks team :thumbsup:
eng_oncall: Follow-ups: 1) SRE to block suspicious IPs found in export. 2) DevEx to add a warning about client-side logging in SDK docs. 3) PM to consider defaulting new customers to KMS-backed keys.
sre_maya: Blocking IPs now. Export attached to ticket.
sec_jun: Closing the security incident once customer confirms no further exposure and we have WORM export completed.
csm_oliver: Customer confirmed rotation complete and no further inbound alerts. Closing from support side.
